rows.name: wrong-candidate-or-pack
rows.perturbation: Alter one expected commit/pack hash in an in-memory binding copy.
rows.requiredObservation: Admission rejects exact mismatch before product module load; positive unchanged binding accepted.

rows.name: recipe-or-oracle-tamper
rows.perturbation: Change one W06 expected digit without updating the sealed manifest.
rows.requiredObservation: Recipe admission rejects hash before execution, not a semantic comparison failure.

rows.name: source-fallback
rows.perturbation: Resolve an import toward the disallowed source/old-layout path, with an observable marker if loaded.
rows.requiredObservation: Loader rejects the exact forbidden URL; zero marker loads. A generic assertion error is not proof.

rows.name: actual-load-not-disk-only
rows.perturbation: Make a controlled test resolver select a wrong hashed module while the expected file remains untouched.
rows.requiredObservation: Actual load trace rejects the selected wrong bytes; disk-only guard would miss it. No production module is patched.

rows.name: fresh-view-new-entry-mode-link
rows.perturbation: Supply a synthetic fresh-view manifest with one unlisted regular entry, mode mismatch, or symlink, using three in-memory subchecks.
rows.requiredObservation: Each designated fresh-view guard rejects; unchanged synthetic view accepted. Never create or copy AGENTS.

rows.name: stdout-byte-fidelity
rows.perturbation: Change exactly binary W03 byte FF to UTF-8 replacement bytes in an in-memory captured record.
rows.requiredObservation: Exact stdout/added-file predicates both detect altered bytes; original literal record accepted.

rows.name: status-and-diagnostic
rows.perturbation: Change a passing capture status0 to7, then add one stderr byte in separate in-memory subchecks.
rows.requiredObservation: Each designated predicate rejects; do not equate nonempty stderr categories or ignore status.

rows.name: namespace-preservation
rows.perturbation: Perturb an initial file byte, add an unexpected final path, and retain W09 stage in separate in-memory records.
rows.requiredObservation: Preservation, exact namespace and absent-path predicates respectively reject; correct record accepted.

rows.name: cleanup-before-credit
rows.perturbation: A harness-only child publishes a matching result but intentionally retains an owned timer/pipe until the supervisor deadline.
rows.requiredObservation: Lifecycle rejects despite matching output; retain natural/forced status and then reap completely. No product invocation needed.

rows.name: guarded-failure-continuation
rows.perturbation: Feed an ordinary assertion failure with closed resources to the coordinator, and separately a binding/cleanup failure.
rows.requiredObservation: Ordinary failure permits next scheduled record; unsafe case halts before next dispatch. No missing tail may be called pass.

rows.name: real-plugin-admission
rows.perturbation: A harness-only plugin blocks setup on a controlled promise; inspect the barrier before and after release, then a rejecting setup subcheck.
rows.requiredObservation: No registry observation before actual preceding setup completion; rejection is captured and disposed. No sleeps or counter reset.

rows.name: no-op-target-substitution
rows.perturbation: Load a separate test-only stub with explicit module hash that returns0 without producing W02 files.
rows.requiredObservation: Designated W02 file/effect predicate rejects despite status0; actual stub load must be observed. Never mutate product or replace the positive run.
